chinese_translations.english: a group of people with a shared language, culture, and history
chinese_translations.example: The census recorded more than fifty nationalities living within the river delta region.

english_explanations: fixed or stated for a particular purpose
already decided, arranged, or accepted as a starting point

chinese_translations.meaning: 规定的；特定的；假设的；已知的
chinese_translations.english: fixed, specified, or accepted as true for the purpose of an argument
chinese_translations.example: For any given volume of gas, the pressure rises as temperature increases.

english_explanations: the first version of something from which copies are made
the earliest form of a work, document, or design

chinese_translations.english: the first version of a document or artwork from which copies are made
chinese_translations.example: The museum displays the original manuscript alongside digital copies for conservation reasons.

english_explanations: a situation in which there is not enough of something needed
the amount by which a supply falls short

chinese_translations.english: a situation in which the supply of something needed is not enough
chinese_translations.example: A shortage of nurses has forced rural clinics to reduce their opening hours.

english_explanations: the scientific study of diseases and their causes and effects
a disease, or the structural changes a disease produces in the body

chinese_translations.english: the scientific study of the nature and causes of disease
chinese_translations.example: Recent advances in pathology have allowed earlier diagnosis of inherited metabolic disorders.

chinese_translations.english: a disease, or unusual and damaging behaviour or condition
chinese_translations.example: The scans revealed pathology in the lung tissue unconnected with the original injury.

english_explanations: the distance north or south of the equator measured in degrees
freedom to choose how to act or think within limits

chinese_translations.english: the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees
chinese_translations.example: Reef corals rarely survive beyond certain latitudes because winter seas grow too cold.

chinese_translations.english: freedom to act, think, or decide within limits
chinese_translations.example: The new charter gives regional councils wider latitude in setting transport budgets.

english_explanations: an exciting and possibly dangerous experience
a brave or unusual activity involving risk

chinese_translations.english: an exciting or dangerous experience or activity
chinese_translations.example: Her account of the polar adventure inspired a generation of young explorers.

english_explanations: the amount of goods, work, or power produced
the information or energy a system sends out

chinese_translations.english: the amount of goods, energy, or work produced by a person, machine, or country
chinese_translations.example: Factory output rose by a quarter after the assembly robots were reprogrammed.

chinese_translations.english: the work or products created by a person or organization
chinese_translations.example: The composer's late output shows a striking return to simple folk melodies.

english_explanations: used to say that something is unlucky or unpleasant
in an unlucky manner

chinese_translations.english: used to introduce an unlucky or regrettable fact
chinese_translations.example: Unfortunately, the public funding programme ended before the final restoration phase began.

english_explanations: happening or moving very quickly
able to respond without delay

chinese_translations.english: moving or happening quickly and without delay
chinese_translations.example: Swift action by rangers contained the forest fire before it reached the pine plantations.

english_explanations: to take someone attention away from what they are doing
to prevent someone from concentrating

chinese_translations.meaning: 转移(注意力)；使分心；扰乱
chinese_translations.english: to take someone attention away from what they should be doing
chinese_translations.example: Smartphone notifications distract students from sustained reading more than any other factor.

english_explanations: to limit or control something by forcing conditions on it
to force someone to behave in a particular way

chinese_translations.english: to limit the size, range, or freedom of something
chinese_translations.example: Tight fiscal rules constrain new investment in rural broadband across the province.

chinese_translations.english: to force someone to act in a particular way
chinese_translations.example: Severe drought constrained many farmers to switch from rice to drought-tolerant crops.

english_explanations: to block or fill a place with fine sand and mud carried by water
to become filled with muddy sediment

chinese_translations.english: to block or fill a riverbed or channel with fine mud and sand carried by water
chinese_translations.example: The old canal silted badly until dredgers reopened the route to narrow barges.

english_explanations: including everything or considering everything as a whole
covering all parts or aspects of something

chinese_translations.meaning: 全部的；全面的；总体的；从头到尾的
chinese_translations.english: considering or including everything as a whole
chinese_translations.example: The overall cost of the metro extension exceeded early estimates by twelve per cent.

english_explanations: to mix different substances or qualities together
to combine flavours, colours, or styles into a pleasant whole

chinese_translations.english: to mix things together so that they combine into one smooth whole
chinese_translations.example: The architect blends traditional motifs with modern glass in the museum extension.

english_explanations: a sea animal or light soft material full of holes that soaks up liquid easily
a person who takes from others without giving anything back

chinese_translations.english: a sea animal with a soft porous body, or a piece of similar material for washing
chinese_translations.example: Natural sponges from the reef once supported an entire island trading economy.

chinese_translations.meaning: 寄生虫；依赖他人生活的人
chinese_translations.english: a person who lives off other people's money or effort without repaying them
chinese_translations.example: Critics branded the failing state utility a sponge soaking up public funds.

english_explanations: mostly or mainly
for the most part, more than anything else

chinese_translations.meaning: 主要地；显著地；占主导地位地
chinese_translations.english: mainly, or more than anything else
chinese_translations.example: The valley population is predominantly rural, with farming shaping nearly every local festival.

english_explanations: extremely clever, skilled, or successful
very bright, shining strongly, or full of vivid colour

chinese_translations.meaning: 卓越的；杰出的；才华横溢的
chinese_translations.english: extremely intelligent, skilled, or impressive
chinese_translations.example: A brilliant young mathematician solved the routing problem that had puzzled engineers for years.

chinese_translations.english: very bright, vivid, or beautiful
chinese_translations.example: Brilliant autumn colours draw landscape photographers to the mountain passes every October.

english_explanations: to say something publicly, firmly, and officially
to state goods or income formally to the customs or tax authorities

chinese_translations.english: to state something publicly and officially
chinese_translations.example: The government declared a state of emergency as floodwaters breached the main levee.

chinese_translations.english: to state officially the value of goods or income to customs or tax officials
chinese_translations.example: Travellers must declare cash above the legal limit when crossing the border.

english_explanations: a connection between two people, things, or ideas
one ring of a chain, or a place in a document that connects to another

chinese_translations.english: a connection between two things, or one part of a chain or system
chinese_translations.example: Researchers recently uncovered a direct link between sleep quality and memory consolidation.

english_explanations: one of several parts that together make up a machine, system, or idea
a part that combines with other parts to form something

chinese_translations.english: one of the parts that make up a whole system, machine, or mixture
chinese_translations.example: Reliable sensors remain the single costliest component of modern weather monitoring networks.
